title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter’ Online With Philo
summary: After 15 years, you can stream the six-part limited reality TV series on Tuesdays on VH1.
contentText:

After 15 seasons, the hit reality series Love & Hip-Hop is coming to an end in 2026. However, before it ends, a new six-part limited reality TV series titled Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter drops on cable networks VH1, as well as MTV and BET.

watch VH1 for free with Philo

The series features cast members from all four cities from the spinoffs, such as New York, Atlanta, Hollywood and Miami. It has new interviews with Stevie J, Joseline Hernandez, Yandy Smith, Mimi Faust, Rasheeda Frost, Trick Daddy, Safaree Samuels, Trina, Ray J, Scrappy and Yung Joc, along with Angela Yee, Nina Parker and Jess Hilarious.

It’s available to access with a subscription to Philo , which is the “ home of reality TV online” and free to watch with a seven-day free trial .

When Does ‘Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter’ Start ?

Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter broadcasts starting on Tuesday (Nov. 10) with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/PT. Each episode is 42 minutes long, while new episodes drop every Tuesday until Dec. 15.

Where to Watch ‘Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter’ Online

Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter airs on VH1, MTV and BET. It’s available to stream on Philo . Keep reading for more details on how cord-cutters can watch the limited reality TV series online with Philo .

How to  Watch ‘Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter’ Online with Philo

A subscription to Philo Essential , which now comes with VH1, MTV and BET, gets you access to live TV from cable channels for just $25 per month — which is very affordable.

In fact, the live TV streaming platform features more than 70 cable networks, such as AMC, A&E, Animal Planet, BBC America, Bravo , Cartoon Network, CMT, Comedy Central, Discovery Channel, EarthX, Food Network, Game Show Network, Hallmark Channel, HGTV, History Channel, Investigation Discovery, IFC, Lifetime, Logo, MotorTrend, MotorTrends, Nickelodeon, OWN, Paramount Network, Pop TV, Revolt, Smithsonian Channel, Sundance TV, TLC, UPtv, Vice, We TV and many others. Plus, Philo has more than 170 FAST channels (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) available to watch too. Overall, that’s more than 240 channels, in total.

Starting on Tuesday (Nov. 10), you can watch Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter on VH1, as well as MTV and BET, with Philo . The six-part limited reality TV series is available to stream on Philo Essential with the service’s seven-day free trial .

Meanwhile, AMC+, Discovery+ and HBO Max are available with Philo Bundle+ , which goes for $33 per month. It comes with access to over 70 cable networks and All Reality programming from AMC Global Media, as well as even more movies and TV shows on AMC+ which features Mad Men , Breaking Bad , Better Call Saul , Gangs of London , Interview with the Vampire , Show Me More , Deadstream and more.

HBO Max also features originals, such as Hacks , House of the Dragon , The Rehearsal and The Last of Us ; all things HBO, like Succession , Veep and Industry ; popular movies, including Sinners , One Battle After Another , Dune and Dune 2 , Barbie , Wonka and others. It’s the home to exclusive Music Box documentaries, such as Yacht Rock: A DOCKumentary , Woodstock ’99: Peace, Love and Rage , Juice WLRD: Into The Abyss , DMX: Don’t Try to Understand and much more.
